text_block_list.text:
"I was invited to observe Neo Universe's 
dance lesson... but."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "outflow" of emotion— "Expressing" it 
is tough, huh.
choice_data_list: She's good at dancing, you know...

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe, okay! Next, try expressing 
your emotions more with your body!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Expressing emotion through the body...

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Unique", huh... Umm... what kind of 
emotion is that...?

"And though she remains behind to practice 
on her own, it seems she has yet to find a 
satisfying answer."
"Well, well, well. So you're still here."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Your steps belong to you. In its own way, 
this really brings out your flavor.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I can definitely feel the emotion behind 
it. I'm pretty picky when it comes to 
dance, so there's no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, well…… as an entertainer, you're 
not quite there yet. You need to make it 
easier to understand, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Simplicity...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We need something that makes it instantly 
clear, even to people who don't know you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All kinds of people watch the Winning 
Live. You want every single one of them to 
feel your emotions and get fired up 
together with you, right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative... What should I do?
choice_data_list:
Getting lessons from Tap Dance City or 
something

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Tell me, Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're picking me as your role model?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe doesn't know what an "icon" 
is.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"First is "INTI"... I want to solidify the 
"fundamentals."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Solid, safe—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
But that's fine! You can't go on an 
adventure if you neglect where you're 
stepping!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you"...! Neo Universe wants to 'get 
hyped' with the audience!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I've received your spirit! Let's blaze a 
new trail!

And so, having danced with Tap Dance City, 
Neo Universe took one step closer to her 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: For... what...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."THNK". What is Neo Universe... trying 
to do with this "dance"...?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was a great race! Good work out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...'Thank you.' I want to convey that.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Far to the back, reach out wide... I want 
everyone to receive my "signal"...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, you understood on instinct 
all along.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nice, your passion's taking over your 
body. Just give in to the flow!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira!

As a result of listening to her inner 
voice, Neo Universe's dance became infused 
with emotion and was polished even 
further.
